# 2400 Franklin Flex Space

> Newly renovated small-bay flex building at 2400 Franklin Rd, Lawrence, KS 66046, across from VenturePark. Eight bays (A–H), most 900 SF (30 × 30 ft) and Bay H 540 SF (18 × 30 ft), combinable, each with a full-height shop floor, kitchenette, private restroom, roll-up door at the back and storefront entry on Franklin Road; Bay A is a tall flex suite with a steel mezzanine office. For small businesses that have outgrown the garage: trades and service crews, makers and fabricators, e-commerce and small brands.

- Owner: Flint Hills Capital, LLC (https://flinthills.capital)
- Location: across from VenturePark, next to East Hills Business Park, on K-10 (about 30 minutes to Olathe), with I-70 and US-59 nearby
- Sister property on the same site: Free State Storage (https://freestatestorage.com) for overflow, inventory, and truck, trailer and equipment parking
- Leasing inquiries: call (785) 727-2112, email leasing@2400franklin.com, or use the form at https://2400franklin.com/#inquire
- Availability is listed at https://2400franklin.com/#bays
